title: WellaPath candidate artifact manifest contract
description: Versioned, additive contract for governed artifact delivery — I3 Step 1. INACTIVE: no route serves or consumes this contract; it exists as repository-only schema, fixtures and validation code. Source of truth is src/manifest/contract.ts; tests/unit/manifest-contract-sync.test.ts fails if this schema drifts from it. The states present, published, approved, active and eligible_for_environment are distinct and never synonyms; eligibility is fail-closed — absent, null, unknown or malformed governance data means NOT eligible. v1.1.0 (I3 Step 2B) adds the optional approval field decision_scope and tightens one previously-unsafe claim: a granted approval that declares no artifact_publication scope no longer counts. Descriptors making no granted-approval claim stay valid; supported major remains 1.

manifest_version.description: Semantic version of this contract. Consumers MUST reject any major version they do not support.

required_features.description: Features a consumer must support to use this manifest. A consumer MUST reject a manifest declaring any feature it does not recognise.

decision_scope.description: What the cited decision actually authorized. OPTIONAL in structure, MANDATORY in effect for a granted approval: absent or null records that no scope was captured, which fails closed once status is granted. A granted approval MUST declare a scope that includes artifact_publication; a decision scoped elsewhere (e.g. product_display wording and ordering) cannot occupy an artifact-publication approval slot, however complete that decision is and whichever authority took it.

approval_record.description: Both approval slots on an artifact descriptor are artifact-publication approval slots. An approval counts ONLY when it is exactly status=granted, with a non-null decision_ref, and a decision_scope that includes artifact_publication. Unknown, missing or malformed scope fails closed.

object_key.description: Immutable object key. Never reused for changed content.

url.description: Optional full URL. Must be HTTPS on an approved origin, resolve to object_key exactly, and carry no credentials, query string or fragment.

rollback_target.description: Explicit version/hash-bound downgrade target. Downgrades are refused without one. Must resolve exactly to a descriptor in the same manifest.

references.description: Traceability references only. Never credentials, tokens or signed URLs.
